text: grep the claude and codex logs for node / bun / python commands related to when using the agent-seat skill, we want to find everything that agents are using and then be able to turn those into useful commands so they no longer have to. /home/siah/.codex /home/siah/.claude
resolution: Surveyed 132 Claude+Codex sessions that used the agent-seat skill and extracted every bun/node/python invocation: 461 escapes, which decompose into four missing capabilities rather than four bad habits. 236 reshaped replies with jq, 155 hand-parsed mesh/doc.blob, 89 did geometry math over look output, 3 slept before a call that might race the editor. The blob readers were already silently wrong — they hardcode RJMD v4's 40-byte header while the format is v5 with 48, and the live editor has both on disk. Built the replacements: tools/seat package info|regions|diff (the editor's own RJMD decoder), measure bbox|distance|contact and stats edges|symmetry|anomalies and align (dry-run reports the delta, apply uses that same delta), --fields for reply shaping, --wait/wait-ready plus an explicit editor-status state of ready|starting|dialog-blocked so a refusal says whether waiting helps. region:/model targets answer from the percept and leave the live selection alone; richer selectors report selectionSet:true instead of clobbering it silently. Verified live against the running editor and covered by 17 new geometry tests plus 9 new seat dispatch tests.
